scope: Deterministic synthetic capacity and current-schema size audit, not learner timing, service availability, mastery, teaching effectiveness or IELTS score evidence. No user data/configuration/real service/browser read or changed.

currentRuntime.personalTimingRule: Recent 30 initial originals: 75th percentile active seconds/word ×1.2; no real samples were read.

contextInventory.method: Exact headwords only, phrases/inflections not expanded. Located means an explicitly taught headword with a nonempty meaning also occurs in an associated or same-day scheduled training input. It does not prove its meaning, sense, level, future output or delayed transfer. Gate/final/independent inputs are excluded from the training-input pool. Missing exact mappings do not mean the learner does not know these words or that inflected forms never occur. No real learner exposure or progress was read.

currentReferenceTime.note: All current day references total 360; they are estimates, not minimums or observed completion times. Primary scenarios assume other skill work takes 55/65/75% of its reference, then reserve separate non-vocabulary reflection and default-style breaks.

profiles.label: Middle occupied time (assumed, not a learner estimate)

parameters.timingSource: Every per-action seconds/probability/factor in the three profiles is an explicit audit assumption, not measured learner/provider data. Code supplies action counts, bounds, timeout, timer defaults, review estimates and record limits.
parameters.measurementEpisodes: Approximation of current 5% clean-skill measurement holds, with rotating recognition/spelling/listening and sampled production. Original runtime cards/due dates are never edited.
parameters.scenarioSeed: FNV1a with Murmur finalizer over fixed profile/slot/day/action strings; deterministic stress outcomes, not learned probabilities.
parameters.breakPolicy: The UI timer defaults off. All primary audit scenarios deliberately reserve breaks using its 25/5/15/4 settings because the 360-minute target includes rest.

storageProbe.scope: Isolated synthetic IDs, scores and answers, actual current six-word V2 artifact/Records/Memory functions and actual public catalog. No professional service, learner records or persistence called. UTF-8 bytes and JS character limits are kept separate.
notes: The complete initial artifacts contain three correct writes, three distinct synthetic recording proofs and all three rounds; synthetic proof fields test size only, not valid real-world evidence.
Other-course originals are content-size baselines; future essays, transcripts, real audio assessments, corrections, 40-version histories, recovery points and index envelopes change the sizes.
The media template is a schema-shaped estimate with one two-second PCM reference; it is not a measured real learner media row.
Large-text-store covers only the logical memory key. It does not remove the Records count cap, server byte limits or whole-profile synchronization cost.

The synthetic other-course content baseline is not an absolute byte lower bound: real submitted answers can be shorter or longer. Whole-profile and NAS budgets need empirical stress tests with representative long feedback and revision histories.
storageProbe.everydayBackupRoute: The complete folder backup is separate from the manual 90MiB/500-item media import path. It retains content-addressed objects for 30 daily manifests; 30 points do not imply 30 full copies of unchanged audio, but changing monolithic text snapshots have different hashes and still accumulate.

recommendations.topic: Context and level coverage before throughput claims
recommendations.required: Map every intended headword to an eligible scheduled input with its exact position, intended meaning/sense, learning level, output purpose and revisit dates. Preserve reserve forms; do not manufacture a context by copying a catalog example. Rebuild the P2/P3 cross-map before enabling additional required vocabulary.

recommendations.topic: End first learning by 330 is a new planning contract
recommendations.required: Days 2–330 provide 329 acquisition days, so cold-start coverage needs an average 24.32 distinct submitted headwords per available acquisition day before absence, errors and delayed work. Current 8000/364 reference is a different window. Treat this as a workload diagnostic, not a fixed daily gate; retain uncovered, unsubmitted and late words.

recommendations.topic: Measure occupied time, not only activeSeconds
recommendations.required: Collect opt-in isolated/real-use telemetry by phase: context study, correct/error typing, permission/capture/encoding, non-silent checks, professional request success/timeout, round playback/answering, corrections and durable sync. Keep three correct writes/three independent valid recordings/three rounds. Do not use observed speed as mastery or fill 360 minutes by force.

recommendations.topic: Immutable archives partitioned by profile and date, with a small index
recommendations.required: Do not merely increase MAX_RECORDS. Append originals and evaluation deltas into bounded immutable date chunks, preserve IDs, exact answers, media hashes and complete revision history; maintain an ID→date/chunk/hash/version index and validated per-day activity summaries. Do not create one loose file per 100000 observations alongside 24000 voice files, which can exceed the current daily-backup file cap. Deduplicate frozen material bodies separately from per-attempt option order. Keep a recent browser window, resolve old first-learning/delayed evidence lazily by record ID, and preserve full-history queries needed by deduplication, mistakes, personalization and backups.

recommendations.topic: Lossless migration and durable-read capability handshake for P4
recommendations.required: Copy legacy Records and Memory evidence into staged archive partitions, verify counts/IDs/hashes and old-format round trips before switching the active index. Keep legacy originals until the verified switch; interrupted copy must resume idempotently. New archive-only writes need an explicit server capability/protocol handshake, unlike P1 opaque snapshot fields. Missing archive records mean pending resolution, never silently unlearned or a fabricated pass.

Back up archive partitions, index, memory state and all referenced original audio together; retain 30 historical daily restore points, cross-tab CAS and restore-time hash checks. Place chunks in an explicitly included backup root, with an index of every retained dependency. Test 8000×4 cards, over 100000 immutable observations, 24000+ clips, restart, offline restore, partial writes, quota, corrupted hashes, stale tabs and NAS interruption. Avoid serializing and rehashing all history per recall. Keep 64MiB-entry/128MiB-cache/128MiB-Records/256MiB-profile, 100000 daily-backup files and 500-item manual media imports explicit.

recommendations.topic: Coverage and delayed verification are different targets
recommendations.required: Current complete-word verification needs two separated independent correct answers for every one of four skills. A 5% production sample cannot provide that evidence for all 8000 words. Decide and document receptive coverage versus productive goals and their workload; do not silently relax the saved evidence rule or count untested skills as mastered.

limitations: No learner history, actual microphone time, real API latency/availability, actual NAS throughput or observed learning outcomes were sampled. Low/middle/high are stress parameters, not calibrated confidence intervals.

The hypothetical 8000 stream is a supply-only upper bound with anonymous slots. It assumes suitable meaningful contexts exist by day330 and does not generate content, assign rank-based compulsory tasks or describe deployed E.plan output. Current runtime does not provide this stream.

The current-context stream only uses structurally located, explicitly listed headwords. Literal matches do not prove the intended meaning, polysemy, CEFR fit, output coverage or first-encounter unfamiliarity. No inflection/phrase expansion is used.

A whole six-word batch is counted only after all modeled first-study work and a durable save allowance finish; unfinished batches, correction work and due words carry. Initial submission is not mastery.

Daily buckets approximate placement of ten-minute short retries and allow other skill work to fill gaps. Only one same-day retry per failed delayed item is budgeted; additional repeated failures or incompatible timing can add workload.

Review outcomes are deterministic pseudo-random stress assumptions independent of FSRS predicted probabilities. Default .9 retention is a scheduling preference, not validated observed success. No actual personalized model is fit.

Counterfactual time-only runs deliberately ignore the existing Records cap. Separate bounded runs enforce it; future large archives must be implemented and migrated before time-only throughput could be operational.
Projected completion dates assume unchanged daily availability and continuing four-skill practice beyond one year; lack of contexts or record capacity yields no claimed completion date.

Storage estimates use actual synthetic record structures but omit real feedback/body variation, revision growth, extra errors, recovery-point copies and some media. They are size evidence, not a safe NAS performance or backup guarantee.

The old vocabulary-load-audit.json/7942 result is not reused as an answer: it omitted meaningful-context supply, default breaks, other skills, 330-day deadline, retries/service wait and immutable-record capacity.

All three primary scenarios already assume other core work takes less than its reference minutes. The high scenario is not a proven worst-case bound; zero-baseline learners, correlated service outages or longer feedback can require more time.
Production review API failures and pending evidence are not fully simulated. Real pending/service failure must retain input and cannot be treated as a correct answer or a forgetting event.

Action times and failure assumptions are held constant within each scenario. They do not model individual improvement, lexical difficulty growth or changing service/NAS performance; early fast completion is not evidence of sustained annual throughput.

timingBlindSpots.source: essential-vocabulary-app.activity returns while controller.getMediaState().busy or saving; vocabulary-speaking.busy includes requesting/recording/saving/assessing.
timingBlindSpots.consequence: activeSeconds-derived minutes/word can omit occupied wall time. The audit includes assumed capture, service timeout and durable-wait time; it does not claim to have measured it.
